first_prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve / style harmonization for an existing game.
There are TWO input images with strictly DIFFERENT ROLES.
IMAGE 1, the SINGLE small rear-facing Achilles on gray, is the ABSOLUTE authority for the exact character design, silhouette, head/body proportions, armor construction, colors, contour thickness and cel-shading. This is the actual published in-game idle sprite. Recreate THAT EXACT Achilles in animation.
IMAGE 2, the magenta 4x3 sheet, is ONLY A BODY-POSE AND LAYOUT GUIDE. Its overlarge shoulders, biceps, broad shiny armor, saturated colors and huge helmet rendering are WRONG and MUST NOT be preserved. Copy ONLY its twelve joint positions, three action families, camera and 4x3 organization. Redraw every figure from IMAGE 1's design.

Make a replacement 4 columns x 3 rows sprite sheet of twelve full-body Achilles poses, facing UP-RIGHT seen from the BACK, matching IMAGE 1 as closely as an animation frame of the same original asset. Keep the original modest/slender upper body and narrow natural arms rather than superhero muscles; same modest head-to-torso ratio and shoulder breadth as image1. Keep image1's OPEN gold-bronze helmet with its original cheek-guard shape and its exact small red crest silhouette; do not make a giant solid neck bucket or wide dome. Restore original small round shoulder clasps, original cuirass contour and warm IVORY #f8e5c4 two-plane backplate (never bright white, no sculpted abdominal/chest anatomy), original deep dark desaturated TEAL #213e42 tunic (not lighter #2e5355), original simple gold hem detail, exact red cloth waist tie/knot/hanging ends. Restore original narrow legs, straps and small brown-bronze strapped sandals. All metal must be MATTE warm bronze/gold with two simple flat shaded planes, no shiny gradients or extra highlights. Thin deep-brown outline matching image1, not the heavy black outline of image2. Do not simplify away the original small silhouette details. No redesign, new belt, backpack, quiver, ornaments, trousers, cape or body glow.

Maintain the pose/actions:
Top row: kneeling on ONE knee, rear-up-right aim. Col1 anticipation, col2 taut full draw with an arrow, col3 RELEASE arrow completely GONE/string relaxed, col4 kneeling follow-through.
Middle row: BOTH feet planted in a low wide braced standing power shot with a torso twist. Col1 anticipation, col2 taut full draw with arrow, col3 RELEASE no arrow or arrowhead and drawing hand pulled back, col4 grounded follow-through.
Bottom row: standing high-bow ballistic volley, bow clearly above the head and aimed upper-right. Col1 lift, col2 high full draw with arrow, col3 RELEASE no arrow and relaxed string, col4 controlled follow-through.
Preserve correct anatomy: left hand holds bow, right hand draws/releases; drawing hand naturally beside cheek/shoulder at release, no extra arms/fingers. The SAME original shield and spear are stowed on back for archery; keep the shield's INNER bronze/dark face and original spear. They must not become larger than on the original identity sprite.
One fixed character scale and camera for all twelve cells; the kneeling head naturally sits lower, never enlarged. Keep the full crest, stowed spear tip, both feet and bow tips inside each cell, with generous separate gutters. Solid flat MAGENTA #FF00FF background everywhere, no gray background, no shadows, no checkers, no labels, no grid borders, no text. Output only the twelve matching animation drawings. Accuracy to image1 matters much more than embellishment.
prompt:
The first attached image is the EXACT existing Achilles sprite, tightly cropped from the published game's idle source. It is the absolute model sheet. Produce frames that can alternate with THIS exact sprite without changing the character, costume, proportions, materials or line style.
The second small beige contact sheet is ONLY a diagram of twelve requested postures. Ignore its rendering and anatomy. Use it only for kneeling / braced / raised-bow joint positions. Do NOT use the previous large magenta model.

Create a 4-column x 3-row sprite sheet of the character in image1, rear three-quarter facing UP-RIGHT. COPY the original shape of his helmet cheek guards and small dome, original red crest geometry, narrow shoulder-to-waist ratio, original arms and fingers, waist red cloth knot, Greek trim, legs and strapped sandals. His cuirass back is the same WARM IVORY (#f8e5c4), with the original sparse angular beige shadows, NOT bright white or an embossed muscle back. Tunic panels must be the same DARK muted teal (#213e42), not brighter blue-green. Bronze shoulder straps, helmet and bracers have the same quiet matte brown shadow planes and tiny highlights as image1; no additional polish or extra round balls for shoulders/biceps. Use the original thin deep-brown line style and simple painted shading. In particular keep the exact crest size relative to the original skull, neither enlarging nor shrinking it. Shield and spear keep their original shapes and proportions but are stowed on the back for bow shooting. The shield presents its dark INNER face in this rear-up-right view.

Row1, piercing: kneeling on one knee, four phases anticipation / full draw with one arrow / release with arrow GONE and string relaxed / kneeling follow-through.
Row2, power: standing low in a broad braced stance with both feet planted, four phases anticipation / powerful full draw with one arrow / release no arrow and drawing hand recoiling beside shoulder / grounded follow-through.
Row3, volley: standing with bow raised high above the helmet toward upper-right, four phases lift / full high draw with one arrow / release no arrow and relaxed string / controlled follow-through.
Left hand holds bow, right hand draws. No extra limbs; fingers and elbows remain anatomically coherent. Exactly 12 separate full-body drawings, 4x3 with clear empty gutters. Do not stretch kneeling bodies to standing height. Same character scale, skin, costume and camera throughout. Retain entire crest, bow tips, spear tip, shield and feet inside each cell.
Perfectly uniform MAGENTA #FF00FF background, no floor shadows, checkerboard, gradients, borders, labels, text or VFX. This is a faithful animation extension of image1, not a redesign or a higher-budget reillustration.
review: Revised with much larger tight identity and tiny beige guide. Original crest/helmet and backplate angles more explicit; pose families and all three arrow-free release cells preserved. Relative palette/proportions still require canonical-scale comparison before selection.
